games.name: Operation: Red Lake [Beta]
games.desc:
Version - 0.2.7
─ ─ ─
You are an operative of the Emergent Threat Tactical Response Authority, a department of the SCP Foundation tasked with responding to various incidents and crises across the globe. While stationed at an ETTRA Command Center somewhere in Northern Canada, you and your fellow operatives were informed that communication with Site 354 was lost after a red mist erupted from the Red Lake, prompting a full site lockdown. ETTRA Operatives and Mobile Task Force units were deployed in order to investigate and regain control of the site. You are a part of the second wave of responders after communication with the first wave was lost. Find out what's going on and complete the mission.

games.name: The Intruder: Continuity
games.desc:
You're alone at home when the phone suddenly rings. A call from the Police Department warns you that a criminal is on the loose, and YOU are his next target. You rush to check the security cameras, scanning every corner for movement. He’s coming. The phone service is down, and you'll have to hide and survive until the phone signal returns.

🖥️ Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Actions: [PC: E, F, Gamepad: X, Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft & CN): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: R2] 
Deep Breathe (For House & CN): [PC: Spacebar, Gamepad: RT]
Open Door (For House): [PC: Double Tap W, Gamepad: Double Tap LS]

NOTE: IF YOU REVIVE, YOU WON'T BE ABLE TO GET ANY BADGES IN THE CONCURRENT SESSION YOU ARE IN.
